import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint, QRect, Qt
from PySide6.QtGui import QAction, QIcon, QIconEngine, QKeySequence, QPainter, QPixmap, QRegion
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget
python.setup:
class GlyphEngine(QIconEngine):
    def __init__(self, glyph):
        super().__init__()
        self._glyph = glyph
    def clone(self):
        return GlyphEngine(self._glyph)
    def pixmap(self, size, mode, state):
        pm = QPixmap(size)
        pm.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
        renderer = fluentqt.FontIcon(self._glyph)
        renderer.setIconSize(min(size.width(), size.height()))
        renderer.setEnabled(mode != QIcon.Mode.Disabled)
        renderer.resize(size)
        painter = QPainter(pm)
        renderer.render(painter, QPoint(), QRegion(), QWidget.RenderFlag.DrawChildren)
        painter.end()
        return pm
    def paint(self, painter, rect, mode, state):
        dpr = max(1, round(painter.device().devicePixelRatioF())) if painter.device() else 1
        painter.drawPixmap(rect, self.pixmap(rect.size() * dpr, mode, state))

anchor = fluentqt.Button("Selection", %PARENT%)
anchor.move(148, 16)
anchor.show()
control = fluentqt.CommandBarFlyout(%PARENT%)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
control.setAnchor(anchor)
control.setLightDismissConsumesPress(True)
def make_command(text, glyph, shortcut=None):
    action = QAction(text, control)
    action.setIcon(QIcon(GlyphEngine(glyph)))
    if shortcut is not None:
        action.setShortcut(shortcut)
    return action

control.addPrimaryAction(make_command("Cut", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Cut, QKeySequence.StandardKey.Cut))
control.addPrimaryAction(make_command("Copy", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Copy, QKeySequence.StandardKey.Copy))
control.addPrimaryAction(make_command("Delete", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Delete, QKeySequence.StandardKey.Delete))
control.addSecondaryAction(make_command("Share", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.Share))
control.addSecondaryAction(make_command("Select all", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.SelectAll, QKeySequence.StandardKey.SelectAll))
favorite = make_command("Favorite", fluentqt.Typography.Icons.FavoriteStar)
favorite.setCheckable(True)
control.addSecondaryAction(favorite)
anchor.clicked.connect(control.open)
